subject.title: fix(gateway): worker workspaces recover after stalled process probes

question: Should this exact-head recovery contract—bounded probes with a retained terminal lease for operator recovery—be accepted for cloud worker workspaces after a current-main merge refresh?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes how a frozen workspace fails and recovers; that availability tradeoff needs owner confirmation beyond automated proof.

options.title: Review and land after merge refresh
options.body: Confirm the terminal-lease operator workflow and validate the current merge result before accepting the bounded recovery behavior.

options.title: Pause for a narrower recovery contract
options.body: Keep the PR open if maintainers want a different operator-facing failure or retry model for unverified worker processes.

recommendation.title: Review and land after merge refresh
recommendation.body: Confirm the terminal-lease operator workflow and validate the current merge result before accepting the bounded recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline assigns this PR to steipete for maintainer review of the availability-sensitive change.
